## System

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  web["apps/web<br/>React 19 + Vite"] -->|HTTP /api| core["apps/core<br/>NestJS"]

  contracts["packages/contracts<br/>zod"] -.-> web
  contracts -.-> core
  core --> pg[(Postgres<br/>drizzle)]

```
